description: Presidential Secretariat - The existence of a Public emergency in Sri Lanka for Public Security
reasoning: This gazette content is a presidential proclamation declaring a state of public emergency and bringing into operation Part II of the Public Security Ordinance. It involves legal powers granted by specific acts and ordinances (Act No. 8 of 1959, Law No. 6 of 1978, Act No. 28 of 1988), making it primarily about legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel, structure, or other specialized categories.
